column1: Run over the full rule set each time a rule version is loaded. A load with an exception is refused.
Every rule has a unique ID
Every from state and to state is a state in its route set
Every state that is not an end state has at least one rule out
Every state except a start state is reached by at least one rule
No two rules in a route set share the same from state, event and condition
Every rule names the owner of the next state
Every route set has at least one end state
